hook: AI helped find PHP flaws; it runs an estimated 70% of websites.
hooks: AI helped find PHP flaws; it runs an estimated 70% of websites.
Governments and companies rushed to patch the bugs.
The language is vital to an estimated 70% of websites globally.
what_happened: AI agents helped uncover critical flaws in PHP, used on an estimated 70% of websites. The PHP Foundation released fixes.
why_it_matters: Patching matters because PHP is estimated to run about 70% of websites, and the FBI warned the flaws could allow remote code execution.
the_catch: Early reporting only: full cleanup could take weeks to months, and the 70% figure is an estimate with no source given.
caption: AI tools helped uncover critical flaws in PHP, which an estimated 70% of websites rely on. Has a site you use ever gone offline?
alt_text: The slides explain that AI helped find critical flaws in PHP, which runs an estimated 70% of websites, and that fixes have been released.

es.hook: La IA ayudó a encontrar fallas en PHP; se estima que PHP se usa en alrededor del 70 % de los sitios web.
es.what_happened: Los agentes de IA ayudaron a descubrir fallas críticas en PHP, que se usa en aproximadamente el 70 % de los sitios web. La PHP Foundation publicó correcciones.
es.why_it_matters: Aplicar parches es importante porque se estima que PHP se usa en alrededor del 70 % de los sitios web, y el FBI advirtió que esas fallas podrían permitir la ejecución remota de código.
es.the_catch: Solo es un informe preliminar: la limpieza completa podría tardar semanas o meses, y la cifra del 70 % es una estimación sin fuente citada.
